# Burning Springs: Resource map for your CAMP

![Burning Springs: Resource map for your CAMP](/uploads/607_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

With the map expansion to Burning Springs, there are now numerous new resources in the new area. Many players like to build their camp on copper, aluminum, lead or iron veins in order to collect ores at the same time. Extractors can be set up on the deposits to make it easier for you to access the ores and extract them.

Here you will find a map of the whole of Applachia including Burning Springs with all available resources:

- Aluminum (EN: Aluminum)
- Black Titanium (EN: Black Titanium)
- Coal (EN: Coal)
- Copper (EN: Copper)
- Crystal (EN: Crystal)
- Ultracite (EN: Ultracite)
- Gold (EN: Gold)
- Iron (EN: Iron)
- Lead (EN: Lead)
- Silver (EN: Silver)
- scrap (EN: junk)
- Phosphate / Fertilizer (EN: Fertilizer)
- Uranium (Nuclear Material) (EN: Uranium)
- Acid (EN: Acid)
- Oil
- Cement Quarry (EN: Cement / Gravel Pit)
- Wood

### Burning Springs map with all extractor deposits

*Click on the map to download full size. If you would like to share the map, it is best to use the link from the article so that the map is not compressed so much when you send it that you can no longer see it.*

![Burning Springs map with all resources](/uploads/nukaknights-post-burning-springs-map-appalachia-burning-springs-resources-1920.jpg) 

The map was created with Mappalachia.
